Power-bay carrier wiring

Carrier as released (b6a53ce7: measured-buck seat, front ears), HV route table; plain top view, fans at the top, PSU end at the bottom. Yellow squares = terminals; dashed = raised run. F# = tie anchor (black) / standoff tie (orange) / stretch post (blue) / retain tower (olive) / mains tie cap (red) / L-leg tie lug on the fence (purple): hover for what it ties, click to show only its runs. SERVICE: to reach the MECCANIXITY breakout screws, cut the stretch-post ties and lift the raised bundle (I2C TMP102->INA3, Mus-14 in) aside. SERVICE: the carrier's front is held by 2 EARS, M3 x 10 pan head self-tap down into the fence's flipped front pads (no stubs); its back by the bar screws. To remove the carrier: lift the IP6518 IN pair (desk build, 8.8 from the right ear screw) and the PIR / fan PWM leads (6.7..9.3 from the left one) aside (no unsoldering). SERVICE: the buck ZK-SJ20 sits +5.0 on its end bars, 4 x M3 x 12 pan head self-tap; its heatsink drops through the deck opening (no shims). Its IN / OUT terminals are raised with the board: BUCK-IN / BUCK-OUT land from above, screwdriver straight down beside the LCD. TIES: every deck run is zip-tied to its anchor (snug); mains ties at every tie cap, snug not cinched, mains only, head + trimmed tail on the cap side off the jacket. Tick to show / hide; click a route (here or on the map) to focus it.
